scope: Actual wallet send transport foundation for funding; no funding submit UI, journal, receipt or credit flow yet.

request.validation: Immutable fully specified EVM transaction; nonzero exact-length addresses, even hex calldata <=64 KiB, uint256 value, positive uint256 gasPrice, positive uint64 gas limit, nonce < 2^64-1. BigInt serialized as canonical hex, no doubles.
request.external: Current selected EOA only, same connected chain, approved eth_sendTransaction method and chain; request on original session topic with one object argument. Never create a replacement wallet or call Privy embedded transport.
request.embedded: Exactly one existing matching Privy wallet, params is one JSON-encoded string per pinned native SDK; same ethSendRpcRequest channel with walletAddress. No createWallet fallback.
request.reown_namespace: New connections request eth_sendTransaction alongside existing sign methods; older sessions lacking approval are rejected before modal request. No implicit permission upgrade or automatic chain switch.
request.gates: Identity/address/signing capability/current generation/caller scope preflight; serial pending-send guard spans wallet prompt, logout and user changes. Reown also guards direct connection sends.

outcomes.not_sent: Typed WalletTransactionNotSent for local validation, session, scope, chain or permission failure before invoking wallet RPC; not used for ambiguous post-dispatch errors.
outcomes.hash_reported: Nonzero 32-byte hex returned by provider. Preserve original hash even if wallet identity changes/logout/disposal occurs before response. This is not receipt, execution or platform credit evidence.
outcomes.rejected: Only structured EIP-1193 4001 (native PlatformException or Reown JsonRpcError). Message text mentioning rejected or 4001 is insufficient.
outcomes.unknown: Timeout, disconnection, generic/wrapped errors, malformed/empty/zero hash, wrong response method or async modal failure. No automatic retry, replacement or fallback.
outcomes.pinned_native_limit: Privy native SDK may normalize provider errors to RPC_REQUEST_FAILED. Dart adapter preserves whatever structured native code exists; it does not reconstruct missing 4001 from strings, so such cases remain unknown.
outcomes.late_errors: Contain async SDK modal errors in send zone without exposing raw payloads or changing an already returned outcome.

remaining: Wire funding confirmation and durable pre-dispatch journal before exposing a submit action; persist hashes under original wallet even after scope loss.
Bind chain receipts and transaction details to original nonce/call, reorg/replacement and unknown-hash recovery, then platform credit tracking.
Explicit safe chain-switch/reconnection flow, final quote/caps checks and native Max; user/platform private BAPI caps remain unavailable this phase.
No app-level deposit/approval workflow is complete solely because transport exists.
